name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Lisbon, he initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering with aspirations of designing sustainable transportation. However, a chance internship with a local karting team ignited a passion for the high-octane world of racing. He quickly shifted his focus, immersing himself in the intricacies of vehicle dynamics and performance optimization.

After graduating, Ricardo honed his skills at smaller racing outfits, steadily climbing the ranks. His meticulous approach to problem-solving and keen eye for detail earned him a reputation as a reliable and innovative engineer. Now, as Technical Director for Oregon Team, Ricardo is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the team's technical operations. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers are encouraged to push boundaries and challenge conventional thinking. His strength lies in his ability to see the big picture while ensuring every component works in harmony.

What sets Ricardo apart is his unwavering commitment to data-driven decision-making. He's known for spending countless hours analyzing telemetry and simulations to identify areas for improvement. He also has a knack for mentoring young engineers, guiding them to reach their full potential.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height, with a lean build that reflects his dedication to fitness.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of espresso throughout the day.
